messages:
Alice: T-minus 40 for the EU change window. Quick go/no-go checklist:
- pin model -> v3.2.1-rc5
- canary at 2% for 15m
- KV cache warmup before canary
- traffic shaper tweak to avoid burst
- quota bump for dedicated pools
Any last-minute vetos? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Pin request queued: model=v3.2.1-rc5 env=prod requester=@alice. To approve run: `deploybot approve pin 3301010101`

Bob: Ack. I'll watch latency and set a temporary alert: p99 > 450ms -> pager.

Carla: Oncall is on. I'll watch error rates & throttles. If embed-cost > 3x baseline during canary -> immediate rollback.

Dinesh: Quick note — traffic-shaper config needs a smaller burst window. Pushing `traffic-shaper.window_ms = 100` now.

deploy-bot: Canary starting: id=cb-3301 fraction=2% duration=15m targets=eu-prod. Monitoring tokens/s, p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate.

oncall-jess: Who's primary for rollback? If spike >50% error rate for 5m we pin back to v3.2.0 and run rollback runbook.

Alice: I'm owning rollback. Rollback steps (short):
1) pause routing to canary via `routectl pause cb-3301`
2) pin models: `deploybot pin --model v3.2.0 --env prod`
3) drain canary pods and revert traffic-shaper
4) post-mortem and alert CS if customer-facing
Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rollback-v3

Bob: I've added an ephemeral dashboard for cb-3301 with anomaly thresholds.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ 3m: p99=380ms, 5xx=0.05%, token-cost delta=+5%. No automatic triggers.

Carla: Kicking off smoke tests against the canary now: `/scripts/smoke_canary.sh cb-3301`

oncall-jess: 12m in — small error bump: 5 -> 15 errors/min (traces show a retry loop in transform lambda). Investigating.

Dinesh: I pushed a conservative fix to traffic shaper earlier. If errors are retry-loop related, we should pause injector that adds extra retries. Doing that now.

deploy-bot: Canary alert: error-rate up 0.12% for 3m. Auto-rollback not triggered (threshold 0.5%).

Carla: Smoke suite result: 98/100 passed, two failures look related to transient upstream timeouts. Not systemic.

Alice: Hold the full rollout. We'll wait the remaining 3m on canary. If no further degradation, proceed to slow roll to 20% over 30m. If errors climb again, we execute rollback steps.

Bob: Copy. I'll keep the dashboard and a short log tail: `kubectl logs -f deploy/cb-3301`

deploy-bot: Canary ended: cb-3301 status=stable summary: p99=390ms, 5xx=0.08%, token-cost+6%. Full rollout queued as slow-roll (2% -> 5% -> 10% -> 20%) with 10m pauses between steps.

Alice: Approving slow-roll. Notifying release-notes owners and CS for heads-up. :thumbsup:

oncall-jess: If we need to stop the slow-roll: `deploybot abort rollout <rollout-id>` and then run rollback steps.

Dinesh: I'll keep the traffic-shaper on the conservative profile until we hit 20%.

Carla: I'll follow up with an automated eval against the sample prompt set post-20% to check quality regressions.

Bob: All set from infra. Let me know when we hit 20% and we can flip the quota bump back to default.

Alice: Thanks team. Official status: GREEN -> slow-roll in progress. Will update channel when we hit 20% or if rollback occurs.
